🎙️ Welcome to My KPOP Idol Egg Farm!

💤 EGGS HATCH AND MONEY STACKS WHILE YOU SLEEP! 🤑
🎶 NEW KPOP IDOL GROUPS ADDED EVERY WEEK! 🎶

🥚 Hatch — Open eggs to get Idols, from common to SECRET!
🤝 Upgrade — Upgrade Idols to get even more Money!
💸 Earn — Get better Idols to make more money and climb the leaderboard.
🌟 Mutations — Some Idols have special forms that are worth more!

💻 Play Anywhere — Works on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console.
